name: PT Tripar Multivision Plus Tbk
summary: PT Tripar Multivision Plus Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a film production company that produces, imports, exports, distributes, and markets films in Indonesia. It operates through the Film, OTT & Internet, Pay TV, Ticket, and Food and Beverage segments. The company offers movies, web series, and soap operas. It also operates pay television networks, such as Galaxy, Galaxy Premium, and IMC channels; and cinema networks, including Platinum Cineplex Cinema.
